quests.instruction: Which solid shape matches a basketball bouncing on the court?
quests.hint: Think of a solid shape that can roll smoothly in every direction.
quests.explanation: A basketball is round all over in every direction, just like a sphere!
quests.funFact: A sphere is like a 3D circle — every point on its surface is the same distance from the center.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape matches a single die you roll in a board game?
quests.hint: Think of a solid shape with 6 flat square faces.
quests.explanation: A die has 6 flat square faces, just like a cube!
quests.funFact: Every face of a cube is a perfect square, and all 6 faces are exactly the same size.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape matches a scoop of ice cream on a cone?
quests.hint: Think of a solid shape with a round flat bottom that narrows to one point.
quests.explanation: An ice cream cone has a round flat top that narrows down to a point, just like a cone!
quests.funFact: A cone has just one flat circle face and one curved surface leading to a point.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape matches a can of soup on the pantry shelf?
quests.hint: Think of a solid shape with two flat circle ends and a curved side.
quests.explanation: A soup can has two flat circle ends and a curved side connecting them, just like a cylinder!
quests.funFact: Cylinders are great for cans because they're strong and stack neatly.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape matches the great stone pyramids in Egypt?
quests.hint: Think of a solid shape with a flat base and triangle sides meeting at one top point.
quests.explanation: An Egyptian pyramid has a flat base with triangle sides meeting at a single top point, just like a pyramid!
quests.funFact: The ancient Egyptian pyramids are some of the oldest and largest structures ever built.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape matches a tissue box sitting on a table?
quests.hint: Think of a solid shape with 6 flat rectangle faces, like a stretched cube.
quests.explanation: A tissue box has 6 flat rectangle faces, just like a rectangular prism!
quests.funFact: A rectangular prism is like a cube that has been stretched longer in one direction.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape matches a round orange sitting in a fruit bowl?
quests.hint: Think of a solid shape that looks round from every single angle.
quests.explanation: An orange is round from every angle, just like a sphere!
quests.funFact: Many fruits grow into a sphere shape because it's a very efficient way to hold juice and seeds inside.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape matches a single sugar cube dropped into tea?
quests.hint: Think of a solid shape where every face is an identical flat square.
quests.explanation: A sugar cube has 6 identical flat square faces, just like a cube!
quests.funFact: Ice cube trays are named after this shape because the ice comes out as little cubes.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape matches a colorful party hat worn at a celebration?
quests.hint: Think of a solid shape that is wide and round at the bottom, narrowing to a point.
quests.explanation: A party hat is wide and round at the bottom and narrows to a point, just like a cone!
quests.funFact: Cone-shaped hats are a popular party design because they sit neatly on your head.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape matches a roll of paper towels in the kitchen?
quests.hint: Think of a solid shape shaped like a tube, round on both ends.
quests.explanation: A paper towel roll is shaped like a tube with round ends, just like a cylinder!
quests.funFact: Cylinders are a common shape for anything that needs to roll or unroll smoothly.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape matches a small paperweight shaped with a pointed top?
quests.hint: Think of a solid shape with flat triangle sides meeting at one point above a flat base.
quests.explanation: This paperweight has flat triangle sides meeting at a point above a flat base, just like a pyramid!
quests.funFact: Pyramids are known for being very stable because of their wide, heavy base.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape matches a cereal box standing on the shelf?
quests.hint: Think of a solid shape like a stretched box with 6 flat rectangle faces.
quests.explanation: A cereal box has 6 flat rectangle faces, just like a rectangular prism!
quests.funFact: Rectangular prisms are a favorite shape for packaging because they stack so neatly.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape matches a shiny marble rolling across the floor?
quests.hint: Think of a solid shape with absolutely no flat parts anywhere.
quests.explanation: A marble is round all over with no flat parts, just like a sphere!
quests.funFact: Marbles roll so smoothly because a sphere has no edges or corners to catch on the ground.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape matches a wooden building block used to stack a tower?
quests.hint: Think of a solid shape with 6 equal square faces, perfect for stacking.
quests.explanation: A wooden block like this has 6 equal square faces, just like a cube!
quests.funFact: Cubes stack neatly on top of each other because every face is flat and equal.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape matches an orange traffic cone placed on the road?
quests.hint: Think of a solid shape with a wide flat bottom that narrows straight up to a point.
quests.explanation: A traffic cone has a wide flat bottom that narrows up to a point, just like a cone!
quests.funFact: Cone shapes are easy to spot and hard to knock over because of their wide base.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape matches a lit candle on a birthday cake?
quests.hint: Think of a solid shape shaped like a tall tube with flat round ends.
quests.explanation: A candle is shaped like a tall tube with round ends, just like a cylinder!
quests.funFact: Cylinders burn evenly because their round shape lets wax melt at the same rate all around.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape matches a shoebox waiting to be packed?
quests.hint: Think of a solid shape with 6 flat rectangle faces, longer than a cube.
quests.explanation: A shoebox has 6 flat rectangle faces, just like a rectangular prism!
quests.funFact: Rectangular prisms come in many sizes, from tiny boxes to giant shipping containers.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape matches planet Earth as seen from outer space?
quests.hint: Think of a solid shape that looks round no matter which side you view.
quests.explanation: Planet Earth looks round from every angle in space, just like a sphere!
quests.funFact: Gravity pulls planets into a round sphere shape as they form.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape matches a tent with triangle-shaped sides meeting at the top?
quests.hint: Think of a solid shape with a flat base and slanted sides meeting at one peak.
quests.explanation: This tent has a flat base with slanted sides meeting at one peak, just like a pyramid!
quests.funFact: Pyramid-shaped tents shed rain easily because water slides right down the slanted sides.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape matches a small block of cheese cut for a snack?
quests.hint: Think of a solid shape with 6 equal flat square faces.
quests.explanation: A cheese cube has 6 equal flat square faces, just like a cube!
quests.funFact: Cutting food into cube shapes makes it easy to measure equal little bites.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape matches a wooden rolling pin used for baking?
quests.hint: Think of a solid shape like a long tube, round at both ends.
quests.explanation: A rolling pin is shaped like a long tube with round ends, just like a cylinder!
quests.funFact: The round cylinder shape of a rolling pin helps it flatten dough evenly.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape matches a gumball dropped from a machine?
quests.hint: Think of a solid shape that is perfectly round in every direction.
quests.explanation: A gumball is perfectly round in every direction, just like a sphere!
quests.funFact: Gumball machines work well because spheres roll smoothly down the chute.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape matches a loaf of bread wrapped and ready to slice?
quests.hint: Think of a solid shape longer than a cube, with 6 flat rectangle faces.
quests.explanation: A loaf of bread has 6 flat rectangle faces, just like a rectangular prism!
quests.funFact: Bread is often baked in rectangular prism pans so every slice comes out even.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape matches a glass paperweight with slanted sides meeting at a point?
quests.hint: Think of a solid shape with a flat base and sides that slant up to one peak.
quests.explanation: This paperweight has a flat base and sides that slant up to one peak, just like a pyramid!
quests.funFact: A pyramid's wide base and narrow top make it a very sturdy shape for a desk decoration.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape matches a Rubik's cube ready to be twisted and solved?
quests.hint: Think of a solid shape with 6 equal square faces, perfect for a twisty puzzle.
quests.explanation: A Rubik's cube has 6 equal square faces, just like a cube!
quests.funFact: Each face of a Rubik's cube is divided into 9 smaller squares that can twist and turn.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape matches a megaphone used to cheer loudly at a game?
quests.hint: Think of a solid shape narrow at one end and wide and open at the other.
quests.explanation: A megaphone is narrow at the mouth end and wide at the open end, just like a cone!
quests.funFact: The cone shape of a megaphone helps direct sound further in one direction.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape matches a battery that powers a flashlight?
quests.hint: Think of a solid shape shaped like a small tube with flat round ends.
quests.explanation: A battery is shaped like a small tube with flat round ends, just like a cylinder!
quests.funFact: Cylinder-shaped batteries fit snugly into round slots inside a flashlight or remote.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape matches a snow globe's glass ball before it's shaken?
quests.hint: Think of a solid shape curved evenly all the way around, with no flat parts.
quests.explanation: A snow globe's glass ball is curved evenly all around, just like a sphere!
quests.funFact: The round sphere shape of a snow globe lets you see the whole scene inside from any angle.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape matches a chunky brick used to build a wall?
quests.hint: Think of a solid shape with 6 flat rectangle faces, sturdy and stackable.
quests.explanation: A brick has 6 flat rectangle faces, just like a rectangular prism!
quests.funFact: Rectangular prism bricks stack together neatly to build strong, even walls.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape matches a triangular roof rising above a tower?
quests.hint: Think of a solid shape with slanted triangle sides meeting at a single top point.
quests.explanation: This tower roof has slanted triangle sides meeting at one top point, just like a pyramid!
quests.funFact: Sloped pyramid roofs help rain and snow slide off instead of piling up.
